sources.title: Multimodal generative AI for human motion understanding and generation ...
sources.snippet: This paper presents an in-depth survey of the use of multimodal Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) with autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) for human motion understanding and generation, offering insights into emerging methods and architectures and their potential to advance realistic and versatile motion synthesis.
